surfaced_definition: A decision counts as surfaced if, before the first draft of the material it affects, the agent either (a) asks the user about it, or (b) states the choice it is making and why, in a way the user could object to. Mentioning it only inside the draft, or only after the user approves, does not count.

options_in_play: Ridership forecasting / urban mobility data (most prominent in memory)
What people think can be inferred from the data they share (primary; faint in memory)

decisions.decision: Which experiences to foreground and which to drop
decisions.persona_preference: Academic materials: foreground the RA observation as motivation and the HCDS project as supporting evidence; use the paper only as evidence of research skill; drop or minimize internship, Kaggle, dashboards, TA. Cover letter: the reverse is fine.

decisions.decision: How to describe Prof. Li's research and which work to connect to

options_in_play: 'Related; I'd like to learn' with honest acknowledgement of a DS background
decisions.persona_preference: Honest: real overlap in motivation, no prior privacy research, coming from DS
